increment_paragraph: **MK-EVENT-CELL-ARRAY-SLOTS** (gateway rule 38a; rule 38's keys, contract specification C04.6.2, USER DECISION 2026-11-01 "I approve the changes of D1-D5.", no clause spelling added): at a withheld declaration carrying a descriptor-cell state (`mk_event_timeout_create`, `mk_event_timeout_destroy`, `mk_event_channel_create`, `mk_event_channel_destroy`) the access gate admits, at a `Borrowed` position, a constant-index element of an integer array member, `X->f[K]`, `S.f[K]`, `&X->f[K]`, `&S.f[K]` (`K` a canonical decimal literal below the declared length; `integer_array_length`, `canonical_decimal`), read as W44-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS's member read of its base with the same typed read, second obligation and accusation; and the probe's admitted actuals of such a call are found under rule 12t's minted `qcore_retained__` name too, so the loop actual (`sched->evl`) and the slots leave the inner classification's gate and rule 38 decides the cell. A variable, negative, out-of-bounds or non-canonical index, a pointer member, a non-integer element, a custody position, a function-map callee and a withheld declaration without cells keep the refusal; with rule 38 off the call refuses. `QCore.CellArraySlots` (33 theorems), `tests/cell_array_slots.rs` (16 tests). The integrator ran the live-route measurement (`baseline:e589ee5a7` to `6066c25f0`, declared). Report: [docs/reports/mk-event-cell-array-slots/README.md](../../reports/mk-event-cell-array-slots/README.md).

ledger.why: Discharged by MK-EVENT-CELL-ARRAY-SLOTS (gateway rule 38a): the access gate admits a constant-index element of an integer array member (`&X->f[K]`, `X->f[K]`, canonical decimal K below the declared length) at a cell-bearing withheld declaration's Borrowed position as W44's typed member read of its base, and matches the probe's admitted actuals under rule 12t's minted name, so Fluent Bit's channel operations reach rule 38; fixtures for each admitted and refused shape and for rule 38 off; QCore.CellArraySlots; measured by the integrator with the declared prediction. Narrower than the DISCHARGE text: only cell-bearing withheld declarations (the rest is RETAINING-CALL-MINTED-NAME-ACTUALS).

ledger.title: W44 admissions at a withheld declaration without cells leave only the outer classification's gate
ledger.text: Registered by MK-EVENT-CELL-ARRAY-SLOTS. Rule 12t classifies a withheld call a second time under its minted name (`qcore_retained__<callee>`); W44-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS's probe keys its admitted actuals by the plain callee, so at every withheld declaration without a descriptor-cell state (`mk_event_add`, `mk_event_del`, the collector setters, msgpack, librdkafka) an actual the probe admitted (a scalar or pointer member read, a member address, through a base this body binds) is refused again by the inner classification's gate unless an older route exempts it there; the RETAINING-CALL-MEMBER-ACTUAL discharge of FB-EVENT-LOOP-RETENTION-AND-REGISTRATION holds only partly (e.g. `mk_event_add(loop, c->ch[0], ...)`, `flb_input_set_collector_event(in, cb, ctx->ch_manager[0], config)` in in_tail_init). Rule 38a matches the minted name for cell-bearing declarations only. DISCHARGE: match the minted name at every withheld declaration (or classify under the plain name), with fixtures per declaration family and a declared measurement of the rows it touches.
